answer: The jade index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 346 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lantern. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the opal queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A farm of 122 pays that 201 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
